verdict.rationale: Attestation is a fair axis for FIDO hardware keys, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions attestation certificates, AAGUIDs, FIDO Metadata Service entries, or any way to verify genuine key models at registration. General WebAuthn compatibility and FIDO2 certification claims are adjacent and do not document this capability.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can verify device attestation at registration to enforce that only genuine, approved key models are enrolled
